# humanKIND Classroom

> humanKIND Classroom is a social skills and kindness curriculum for Pre-K through Grade 2, created by Montessori-trained early childhood educator and children's book author Cara Zelas.

humanKIND Classroom helps young children build social skills, emotional awareness, and kindness habits through picture books, puppets, lesson plans, visual tools, and classroom community routines. It is designed for preschool and elementary teachers who want a ready-to-use, play-based curriculum that fits into daily routines.

## Products

- [humanKIND Classroom Kit](https://humankindclassroom.com/kit.html): A complete social skills curriculum for Pre-K through Grade 2. Includes picture books, lesson plans, puppets, visual anchor charts, and classroom community tools. Covers 9 character themes: Kindness, Respect, Empathy, Teamwork, Fairness, Self-Control, Responsibility, Problem Solving, and Courage.
- [Free Classroom Starter Pack](https://humankindclassroom.com/index.html): A free mini curriculum for teachers, including a sample lesson plan, feelings anchor chart, and community circle prompts.

## About

[About Cara Zelas](https://humankindclassroom.com/about.html): Cara Zelas is a Montessori-trained early childhood educator, children's book author, and founder of humanKIND Classroom and Big World of Little Dude. She has taught Pre-K and kindergarten for over a decade and writes curriculum rooted in real classroom experience.
